entities.name: Wojciech Jaruzelski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leader of Poland (1981–1990 (various roles)). Communist general; declared martial law December 13, 1981 (to prevent Soviet invasion, he claimed); crushed Solidarity; last communist leader; Round Table Talks; debated whether villain or savior; die
